request: I curate Morpho's Sentora RLUSD Main vault. A market cap raise I submitted has passed its timelock, and I want to execute it from my Safe. build me the template and its report

title.en: Execute a Morpho Vault V2 market cap increase after its timelock
title.zh-TW: 在 timelock 過後執行 Morpho Vault V2 市場上限的提高

summary.en: The Safe calls the vault's `multicall` with one `increaseAbsoluteCap`, which executes a raise of the market's absolute cap queued earlier with `submit`. It reverts unless that exact raise was queued and its timelock has passed. It moves none of the Safe's assets.
summary.zh-TW: Safe 呼叫 vault 的 `multicall`，裡面一個 `increaseAbsoluteCap`，執行先前用 `submit` 排隊的市場絕對上限提高。除非這筆一模一樣的提高已排隊且 timelock 已過，否則會 revert。不動 Safe 的任何資產。

intro.en: Morpho Vault V2 spreads deposits across Morpho Blue markets. The curator sets each market's cap; a raise is queued with `submit` and runs only after the timelock, when anyone may execute it.
intro.zh-TW: Morpho Vault V2 把存款分到 Morpho Blue 市場。curator 設定每個市場的上限；提高要先 `submit` 排隊，timelock 過後才能執行，任何人都可以執行。

text.en: Vault V2's GitHub lists 18 audit files: Vault V2 itself by Spearbit (3), Zellic, Blackthorn, ChainSecurity and a contest; the market adapter V2 by Blackthorn, Certora and Spearbit; and later add-ons.
text.zh-TW: Vault V2 的 GitHub 列了 18 份稽核檔：Vault V2 本身有 Spearbit（3 份）、Zellic、Blackthorn、ChainSecurity 和一場競賽；市場轉接合約 V2 有 Blackthorn、Certora、Spearbit；其餘是後來的附加合約。

text.en: The vault runs a raise only when the call's bytes equal the ones queued with `submit`, so a market or amount other than what you queued reverts. Anyone may execute it once the timelock has passed.
text.zh-TW: vault 只在呼叫的位元組和 `submit` 排隊的一模一樣時才執行，所以市場或數量和你排隊的不同就會 revert。timelock 過後任何人都能執行。

recommendation.en: Type the market and the exact cap you submitted. verify also checks that the queued entry is cleared and the cap becomes your amount.
recommendation.zh-TW: 填你提交時的市場和一模一樣的上限。verify 也會檢查排隊紀錄被清掉、上限變成你填的數量。

text.en: This template executes one market's absolute cap in a `multicall` of one item, the shape the curator sent for every single raise. Opening a market, with its relative and collateral caps in one batch, is another template.
text.zh-TW: 這個模板在只有一項的 `multicall` 裡執行一個市場的絕對上限，curator 每次單獨提高時都這樣送。開新市場（連相對上限和抵押品上限一起送）是另一個模板。

recommendation.en: Use it to execute one market's raise. Any other shape gets MISMATCH: do not sign it, ask for that template.
recommendation.zh-TW: 用來執行單一市場的提高；其他寫法會判 MISMATCH，不要簽，改要那個模板。

1.multicall.data.en: The calls the vault runs, fixed at one item: the `increaseAbsoluteCap` you queued. Another item, such as a relative cap or a second market, gets MISMATCH.
1.multicall.data.zh-TW: vault 執行的呼叫，固定一項：你排隊的 `increaseAbsoluteCap`。多一項（例如相對上限或第二個市場）會判 MISMATCH。

1.multicall.data[0].en: Item 1: executes the queued raise. It reverts unless these exact bytes were submitted and the timelock has passed; it then clears the queued entry.
1.multicall.data[0].zh-TW: 第一項：執行排隊的提高。除非這串位元組一模一樣被提交過且 timelock 已過，否則 revert；執行後清掉排隊紀錄。

1.multicall.data[0].increaseAbsoluteCap..en: The data that identifies the cap. The vault uses its keccak256 as the cap's id; here it means "this market in this adapter".
1.multicall.data[0].increaseAbsoluteCap..zh-TW: 上限的編號資料。vault 用它的 keccak256 當上限的 id，這裡是「這個轉接合約裡的這個市場」。

1.multicall.data[0].increaseAbsoluteCap..en: The kind of id, fixed to this/marketParams: a cap on one market, not on the whole adapter or on a collateral token.
1.multicall.data[0].increaseAbsoluteCap..zh-TW: id 的種類，固定是 this/marketParams：單一市場的上限，不是整個轉接合約或某個抵押代幣的。

1.multicall.data[0].increaseAbsoluteCap..en: The vault's market adapter, through which funds go into Morpho Blue markets.
1.multicall.data[0].increaseAbsoluteCap..zh-TW: vault 的市場轉接合約，錢經由它放進 Morpho Blue 市場。

1.multicall.data[0].increaseAbsoluteCap..en: The market's five parameters, which together are the market you pick.
1.multicall.data[0].increaseAbsoluteCap..zh-TW: 市場的五個參數，合起來就是你選的市場。

1.multicall.data[0].increaseAbsoluteCap..en: The token the market lends, equal to the vault's asset.
1.multicall.data[0].increaseAbsoluteCap..zh-TW: 市場借出的代幣，等於 vault 的資產。

1.multicall.data[0].increaseAbsoluteCap..en: The token borrowers post as collateral in this market.
1.multicall.data[0].increaseAbsoluteCap..zh-TW: 借款人在這個市場抵押的代幣。

1.multicall.data[0].increaseAbsoluteCap..en: The oracle that prices the collateral in the loan token; a different oracle is a different market.
1.multicall.data[0].increaseAbsoluteCap..zh-TW: 以借出代幣給抵押品定價的 oracle；換 oracle 就是另一個市場。

1.multicall.data[0].increaseAbsoluteCap..en: The loan-to-value at which a borrower is liquidated, such as 86%.
1.multicall.data[0].increaseAbsoluteCap..zh-TW: 借款人被清算的貸款價值比，例如 86%。

1.multicall.data[0].increaseAbsoluteCap..en: The most of the vault's asset this market may hold, in RLUSD with 18 decimals. It must equal the amount you submitted; it reverts if below the current cap.
1.multicall.data[0].increaseAbsoluteCap..zh-TW: 這個市場最多能放多少 vault 資產，單位 RLUSD（18 位小數）。必須等於你提交的數量；低於目前上限會 revert。

role.en: The factory that creates Vault V2 market adapters. It answers `isMorphoMarketV1AdapterV2` = true: it created the adapter
role.zh-TW: 建立 Vault V2 市場轉接合約的工廠，它回答 `isMorphoMarketV1AdapterV2` = true，轉接合約是它建立的

role.en: The Morpho Vault V2 factory. It answers `isVaultV2` = true: it created the vault
role.zh-TW: Morpho Vault V2 工廠，它回答 `isVaultV2` = true，vault 是它建立的

role.en: Morpho Blue itself; the markets live inside it
role.zh-TW: Morpho Blue 本體，市場在它裡面

role.en: The vault's asset, also the token the market lends; the absolute cap is counted in it
role.zh-TW: vault 的資產，也是市場借出的代幣；絕對上限以它計算

text.en: Ripple's RLUSD token addresses page (find-sources read it today) lists it under "RLUSD token addresses" as "Proxy address".
text.zh-TW: Ripple 的 RLUSD 代幣地址頁（今天用 find-sources 讀過）在「RLUSD token addresses」下列為「Proxy address」。

text.en: Etherscan: verified as StablecoinProxy, compiler 0.8.26. The Morpho API answers it as the market's loan asset and the vault's asset.
text.zh-TW: Etherscan：驗證名稱 StablecoinProxy，編譯器 0.8.26。Morpho API 回答它是市場借出資產，也是 vault 資產。

role.en: The market's collateral token, Kraken's wrapped BTC
role.zh-TW: 市場的抵押代幣，Kraken 的包裝 BTC

text.en: Kraken's support article "What is kBTC?" (find-sources read it today) shows this address.
text.zh-TW: Kraken 支援文章「What is kBTC?」（今天用 find-sources 讀過）列出這個地址。

text.en: Etherscan: verified as KBTCProxy, compiler 0.8.24. Morpho Blue's `idToMarketParams` for the market answers it as collateral.
text.zh-TW: Etherscan：驗證名稱 KBTCProxy，編譯器 0.8.24。Morpho Blue 的 `idToMarketParams` 對這個市場回答它是抵押品。

role.en: The oracle the kBTC market uses to price kBTC in RLUSD
role.zh-TW: kBTC 市場用來以 RLUSD 為 kBTC 定價的 oracle

text.en: Morpho API `marketById` for market 0x15bb2a6af0c909eed19fb1f2ceeead34ecbdcba626de752c6b09389ee14eec32 answers this oracle, kBTC, RLUSD and LLTV 86%.
text.zh-TW: Morpho API `marketById`（市場 0x15bb2a6af0c909eed19fb1f2ceeead34ecbdcba626de752c6b09389ee14eec32）回答這個 oracle、kBTC、RLUSD、LLTV 86%。

text.en: On chain today, Morpho Blue's `idToMarketParams` for that id answers this oracle, kBTC, RLUSD, the adaptive curve IRM and LLTV 86%.
text.zh-TW: 今天在鏈上讀 Morpho Blue 的 `idToMarketParams`，這個 id 回答這個 oracle、kBTC、RLUSD、adaptive curve IRM、LLTV 86%。

text.en: AI has no browser that runs JavaScript, so it did not open the market's page on the Morpho app. Today AI read Morpho Blue's `idToMarketParams` on chain for market id 0x15bb2a6af0c909eed19fb1f2ceeead34ecbdcba626de752c6b09389ee14eec32; the oracle it answers is 0xBCC3D9834b84B32Cf540DBE948DEd4B47bec5ddb. The id is the hash of the five parameters, so another oracle is another market.
text.zh-TW: AI 沒有能跑 JavaScript 的瀏覽器，沒打開 Morpho app 的市場頁。AI 今天在鏈上讀 Morpho Blue 的 `idToMarketParams`（市場 id 0x15bb2a6af0c909eed19fb1f2ceeead34ecbdcba626de752c6b09389ee14eec32），回答的 oracle 是 0xBCC3D9834b84B32Cf540DBE948DEd4B47bec5ddb；id 是五個參數的 hash，換 oracle 就是另一個市場。

recommendation.en: Open the market's page on the Morpho app and compare the oracle address yourself.
recommendation.zh-TW: 自己在 Morpho app 打開市場頁比對 oracle 地址。
